title: Restriction normalization of intrinsic proper/open alpha
statement:
Let $B$ be a commutative ring. On the small pro-etale site of a scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], use the module sheaves over the constant ring $B$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the specified inverse-image functors $P_f$ [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], and the specified open extensions $L_j\dashv P_j$ with units $u_j$ [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. Let $k:V\to W$ and $i:S\to T$ be quasi-compact open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $r:V\to S$ and $p:W\to T$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and fix $h:pk=ir$. Write $\sigma_{k,r,p,i}:P_rP_i\cong P_kP_p$ for the specified square comparison and $\alpha:P_pL_i\to L_kP_r$ for the intrinsic clopen alpha [def-cbc-strict-tower-ordinary-proper-open-arrows]. For every module sheaf $M$ on $S$,
$$P_k(\alpha_M)\circ\sigma_{k,r,p,i,L_iM}=u_{k,P_rM}\circ P_r(u_{i,M}^{-1}).$$
The units and all comparisons are the specified ones, rather than arbitrary identifications.

proof.text: For a cartesian square with opens, expand the hom-equivalence formula for the inverse transpose defining beta. Cancel the invertible beta and the invertible open unit. This gives the restriction of beta as the inverse-image square comparison followed by inverse image of the inverse open unit and the target open unit.

Factor the proper/open square through Z = W times_T S, with b:Z -> W open, q:Z -> S, and the clopen lift s:V -> Z. The alpha definition is beta followed by L_b of the clopen projector, the unit-preserving open compositor, and the inverse-image compositor for sq=r. The projector theorem gives P_s(pi_s)=u_s. The unit formula for the adjoint compositor identifies the restriction of the open compositor with the units of s,b,k. Naturality moves the beta across the compositor; u_s cancels its inverse and the previous step cancels u_b. The identical functorial word is packaged before specializing, and its generic component formula is used for the calculation.

proof.text: The two inverse-image compositor coherence equations for sbp=kp and sqi=ri identify the product of the outer square comparison, the compositor for sb=k, and P_s of the pullback square comparison with the compositor for sq=r. Move the inverse open unit along this last natural isomorphism and cancel the isomorphism with its inverse. Finally cancel the inverse k-unit, obtaining the displayed equation. Empty opens and the zero ring require no extra assumptions. Carry out this categorical word calculation for abstract functors before specializing it to the module functors.

lean.statement:
theorem singleAlpha_restriction_normalized {V W S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : Modules B S) :
    (moduleSquareG B k r p i h).hom.app ((moduleJ B i).obj M) ≫
        (modulePullback B k).map ((singleAlpha B k r p i h).app M) =
      (modulePullback B r).map
        ((@asIso _ _ _ _ (moduleJAdj B i).unit
          (clopenModule_openUnit_isIso B i)).inv.app M) ≫
        (moduleJAdj B k).unit.app ((modulePullback B r).obj M)
